result.instructions: Tools for Extensiv, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which open orders does my warehouse have for customer 12?"; "How much stock of SKU ABC-1 is available in each facility?"; "Show the receivers that arrived this week, with their line items.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Extensiv data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run extensiv_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run extensiv_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run extensiv_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. extensiv_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: extensiv_list_facilities
tools.title: List facilities
tools.description: List the warehouse's facilities with their ids and properties (facility ids are needed for orders, stock details and receivers). GET /properties/facilities.

tools.name: extensiv_list_carriers
tools.title: List carriers and services
tools.description: List the carriers with their shipment services (modes) and billing codes, the values an order's routingInfo and billingCode must use. GET /properties/carriers.

tools.name: extensiv_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the warehouse's customers (the companies whose goods it stores), with their customer ids. GET /customers.

rql.description: Optional RQL filter, for example `ReadOnly.CustomerIdentifier.id==1` or `readonly.processDate=gt=2026-10-01T00:00:00;readonly.processDate=lt=2026-10-02T00:00:00` (';' = and).

pgnum.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Use totalResults and _links.next of the previous reply.

tools.name: extensiv_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: One customer by customer id: company info, contacts and settings. GET /customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: extensiv_list_items
tools.title: List a customer's items
tools.description: List the items (SKUs) of one customer, with item ids, descriptions and units. Filter with rql, for example `sku==ABC-1`. GET /customers/{customer_id}/items.

rql.description: Optional RQL filter, for example `ReadOnly.CustomerIdentifier.id==1` or `readonly.processDate=gt=2026-10-01T00:00:00;readonly.processDate=lt=2026-10-02T00:00:00` (';' = and).

tools.name: extensiv_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List outbound orders matching an RQL filter, for example `ReadOnly.CustomerIdentifier.id==1` or `readonly.processDate=gt=2026-10-01T00:00:00` (orders closed after that time). Use detail=OrderItems to include the line items. Orders carry the ship-to name, address and contact details (personal data). GET /orders.

tools.name: extensiv_create_order
tools.title: Create an order
tools.description: WRITE: submit a new outbound order for a customer and facility (the warehouse will pick and ship it). Not idempotent: calling twice creates two orders, so check extensiv_list_orders for the reference_num first. Needs ids from extensiv_list_customers, extensiv_list_facilities and SKUs from extensiv_list_items; billing_code, carrier and mode are required by Extensiv and must come from extensiv_list_carriers. POST /orders.

customer_id.description: The customer id the order is for.

facility_id.description: The facility id that fulfils it.

reference_num.description: Your reference number for the order (for example a PO or web-shop order number).

state.description: State or province code, for example CA.

country.description: Two-letter country code, for example US.

billing_code.description: Freight billing code as listed for the carrier by extensiv_list_carriers (billingCodes), for example Prepaid or BillThirdParty.

carrier.description: Carrier name, for example UPS (from extensiv_list_carriers).

mode.description: The carrier's service mode code (from extensiv_list_carriers).

account.description: The shipper account number for third-party or collect billing.

tools.name: extensiv_cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel an order
tools.description: WRITE: cancel one order by transaction id, with a reason and an optional cancellation fee. This cannot be undone; the order must be in a state the warehouse can still cancel (otherwise Extensiv answers with an error). The tool first reads the order to get the ETag Extensiv requires (If-Match). POST /orders/{transaction_id}/canceler.

charge.description: Cancellation fee to bill, 0 (default) if none.
